title: Human-adopted projections
description: adopt-projection's own part, appended to rather than edited into 00-triage.json's sealed dispositions and deficiencies directly, so re-sealing stays idempotent and cannot erase a human's gate-0 admission, and a new catalogue candidate does not make an already-packed slice plan stale. Required and may be empty: no human has necessarily adopted anything, and triage-seal folds this file in unconditionally rather than treating its absence as a defect.

candidate_id.description: The catalogue candidate this adoption minted for the projection's manufactured artifact -- the same id disposition.candidate_id names, kept at this level too so a reader can find the row without opening the disposition object.

disposition.description: The admit disposition a human authored at gate 0 (authority: human), structurally indistinguishable from any other disposition except for living in this file rather than a slice's part.

projection_id.description: Which 00-audit.json projection this adoption satisfies. triage-seal sets that projection's satisfied_by to candidate_id when it folds this file in.

closed_deficiency_ids.description: The deficiencies this adoption closes -- normally the projection's own closes list, confirmed by the human rather than merely inherited. triage-seal sets closed_by to projection_id on each one named here.
